name: Projection formula
text: If $W$ is a subspace of $\real^m$ having an orthogonal basis $\wvec_1,\wvec_2,\ldots, \wvec_n$ and $\bvec$ is a vector in $\real^m$, then the orthogonal projection of $\bvec$ onto $W$ is $$ \bhat= \frac{\bvec\cdot\wvec_1}{\wvec_1\cdot\wvec_1}~\wvec_1 + \frac{\bvec\cdot\wvec_2}{\wvec_2\cdot\wvec_2}~\wvec_2 + \cdots + \frac{\bvec\cdot\wvec_n}{\wvec_n\cdot\wvec_n}~\wvec_n\text{.} $$
